title: Milnor sequence for resolved reduction sections
statement: In the setting of [lem-sfb-reduction-sections-roos-triangle], let $L\in D(\mathbf{Ab})$ and let $z:L\simeq Q\operatorname{Roos}(\Gamma^{\mathrm{Tow}}I)$ be any isomorphism. For every integer $q$ there exist maps forming a short exact sequence $0\to R^1\lim_n H^{q-1}R\Gamma(K_n)\to H^q(L)\to\lim_n H^qR\Gamma(K_n)\to0$. Both inverse-limit functors are the actual functors on abelian-group towers and retain the canonical quotient transitions. No completeness, upper bound or Mittag--Leffler assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0D6K, lemma-RGamma-commutes-with-Rlim; Tag 0A07, lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim; Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok

proof.text: Use the specified Roos triangle on the actual reduction section tower. Transport its first vertex along z, its first arrow to z followed by the original projection, and its last arrow to the original boundary followed by z inverse shifted by one. The triangle isomorphism has components z,id,id, so the transported triangle is distinguished.
Apply milnor_shortExact in degree q to the transported triangle and the full canonical reduction section tower. Its existential maps and short exactness give precisely the claimed sequence.

theorem reduction_sections_milnor
    (K : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E U))
    (P : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E U) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (AdicCompletion.Modules l E U) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K)
    (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ AdicCompletion.Modules l E U) ℤ)
    (hI : I.IsKInjective)
    (j : Functor.ofOpSequence
      (X := fun n : ℕ ↦ (AdicCompletion.level l E U n).obj P)
      (AdicCompletion.levelStep l E U P) ⟶ I.asFunctor)
    (hj : ∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso (j.app (op n)))
    (L : DerivedCategory Ab.{u + 1})
    (z : L ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (roosF.obj (sectionTower l E U I))) (q : ℤ) :
    ∃ (a : ((lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{u + 1}) ⥤ Ab.{u + 1}).rightDerived 1).obj
          (AdicCompletion.derivedTower l E U K ⋙ rgamma l E U ⋙
            DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} (q - 1)) ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} q).obj L)
      (b : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} q).obj L ⟶
        limit (AdicCompletion.derivedTower l E U K ⋙ rgamma l E U ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} q))
      (hz : a ≫ b = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk a b hz).ShortExact
